mentions.name: Codirigent
mentions.description: A terminal-based IDE built in Rust for running parallel coding CLI workflows with Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. It offers custom layouts with drag-and-drop window management, auto-resume of the last working session on startup, notifications, direct image copy-paste into the AI coding CLIs, and a file tree with right-click to insert file paths into a session. Works on Windows and macOS and is fully open source.
